emilia: Heads-up — All‑hands tomorrow 10:00am PT. Cross-team drop-in with execs, ops, and a short engineering demo. Quick agenda below; drop Qs here or DM me. Recording will be available after the meeting. :calendar:

tariq: Can we include a short Dedicated SLA update? Infra teams keep pinging about latency targets.

emilia: Added — thanks. We'll do a 3‑5min SLA + Qs item. @michael will demo the streaming fallback behavior as part of the rollout update.

michael: I can do a 6min demo (screen share + one slide) showing the fallback path and observed p95 improvements.

sarah: Please include Private/VPC networking Qs — customers asked about routing and KMS integration.

emilia: Yup — allocating time for Private deployment questions.

kate: Friendly reminder: please join a couple minutes early to test audio/video. :coffee:

ops-bot: Reminder posted — All‑hands scheduled: 2025-11-02T17:00:00Z (10:00 PT). Recording: enabled.

emilia: Agenda (brief):
```
- 10:00 — Quick leadership kick-off (5m)
- 10:05 — Product & Launch callouts (10m)
- 10:15 — Dedicated SLA update + metrics (5m)
- 10:20 — Engineering demo: streaming fallback (6m)
- 10:26 — Incident postmortem highlights (5m)
```

emilia: If you have a question that needs prep, paste it here (or add to the slido link below).

emilia: Slido/Qs: https://slido.com/rdw-inference-allhands-1125 (add your Qs and upvote)

tariq: Also — can we surface the canary metrics for the new rollout? A single slide with p50/p95 and error rates would help.

emilia: Good call. @michael will add that slide.

-- AFTER MEETING --
emilia: Thanks everyone — recording and slides are up: https://internal.redwood/recordings/1755559999 and https://internal.redwood/slides/1755559999

emilia: Top takeaways: 1) Dedicated SLA clarified — new p95 latency target is 220ms for standard instances; 2) Streaming fallback reduced p95 by ~18% in the canary; 3) Private/VPC rollout has new network checklist for customers.

tariq: Appreciate the SLA clarification. Action: infra to publish the updated SLO doc by EOD Friday.

michael: Action: share demo repo + small runbook for streaming fallback (PR open: github.com/redwood-inference/stream-fallback/pull/42).

sarah: Action: security to confirm KMS onboarding steps with legal — will update next week.

emilia: If you were assigned an action above, please add the Asana/Ticket and tag me. I'll follow up in the Exec sync next week.

emilia: If anyone couldn't make it or wants a short recap thread, reply here and I'll post a 1‑pager. :memo:

kate: Great meeting, thanks folks! :rocket:
